## Local toolchain note

On the macOS validation host, the release Wasm step required invoking `wasm-pack`
directly with the dynamic-loader environment preserved. The npm child shell stripped
that environment on this host. The direct release build passed, so this was a local
toolchain-environment quirk rather than a source or Wasm build failure.
